dialect.detail: AcuCOBOL-GT or ACUCOBOL dialect: uses DISPLAY MESSAGE ... TITLE ... ICON syntax, 78-level constants, and SPECIAL-NAMES decimal-point is comma — typical of Acu/RM-COBOL Italian business applications

purpose.domain_detail: Warehouse/inventory movement file correction — fixes records where both rmo-peso-tot and rmo-peso-tot-utf (total weight and total UTF weight) are simultaneously populated, zeroing out the non-UTF weight field
purpose.summary: This program scans an indexed file of warehouse movement records (RMOVMAG) and corrects data integrity issues where both the total weight and total UTF weight fields are non-zero simultaneously. It zeroes out the non-UTF total weight field and rewrites the record, then reports the count of corrected records. It is a one-shot data correction utility.

notable_features: DISPLAY MESSAGE ... TITLE ... ICON (AcuCOBOL/RM-COBOL GUI dialog syntax)
DECLARATIVES with USE AFTER ERROR for file error handling
START with KEY >= for indexed file positioning
COPY for both SELECT (.sl) and FD (.fd) copybooks
verdict.notes: Dialect is likely AcuCOBOL-GT based on the DISPLAY MESSAGE/TITLE/ICON GUI syntax; RM-COBOL is also possible. The program is in Italian and appears to be a production data-fix utility for an Italian ERP/warehouse system. No ENVIRONMENT DIVISION detected mechanically but SPECIAL-NAMES and FILE-CONTROL are present (counted under DATA division by the parser). Encoded in latin-1 consistent with Italian text (accented characters in comments).
